title: Full .woodpecker.yml Replacement and Test Suite Consolidation
description: Restructure .woodpecker.yml into staged pipeline with reusable steps, matrix builds, and centralized secrets. Consolidate test suite into unit/integration/smoke/acceptance with shared DORA logging utility.

tasks.title: Create DORA logging utility script
tasks.description: Create scripts/dora-log.sh with dora_start, dora_end, dora_info, dora_warn, dora_error functions for structured JSON logging. Make it sourceable in pipeline steps.
acceptance: Functions emit valid JSON with @timestamp, level, logger, message, pipeline, repo, step fields
Script can be sourced in alpine:3.20 and python:3.12-slim containers

tasks.title: Create reusable step definitions
tasks.description: Create .woodpecker/steps/common.yaml with YAML anchors for common step patterns: dora-logging, gitleaks-scan, trivy-fs, trivy-image, sonarqube-sast, defectdojo-upload, notify-obs, init-artifact-dirs, yamllint, shellcheck.
acceptance: All 10 anchors defined with proper structure

tasks.title: Restructure .woodpecker.yml into staged pipeline
tasks.description: Rewrite .woodpecker.yml using stages (validate, test, security, build, publish, deploy), matrix builds, reusable step anchors from .woodpecker/steps/common.yaml, centralized environment/secrets at top level, and stage dependencies.
acceptance: Pipeline has 6 explicit stages: validate, test, security, build, publish, deploy
Validate stage runs lint-yaml, lint-shell, lint-markdown in parallel
Test stage runs unit-tests (matrix), integration-tests, contract-tests in parallel
Security stage runs sequential gates: secrets-scan → sast-sonarqube → vuln-scan-fs → vuln-scan-image
Publish stage pushes image and uploads to DefectDojo (main only)
All from_secret references moved to top-level or stage-level environment

tasks.title: Create integration test directory and tests
tasks.description: Create tests/integration/ with test_pipeline_contract.py (moved/expanded from unit) and test_compose_integration.py for cross-component validation.

tasks.title: Create smoke test directory and tests
tasks.description: Create tests/smoke/ with test_woodpecker_health.py and test_sonarqube_health.py for deployment verification.

tasks.title: Create acceptance test directory and tests
tasks.description: Create tests/acceptance/ with test_full_pipeline.py for end-to-end pipeline validation.

tasks.title: Update tests/conftest.py and pytest.ini for consolidated structure
tasks.description: Expand conftest.py with shared fixtures for all test types. Update pytest.ini with markers (unit, integration, smoke, acceptance) and test paths.
acceptance: conftest.py provides fixtures: project_root, compose_file, compose_config, woodpecker_file, woodpecker_config, env_example, docker_compose_file, docker_compose_config
pytest.ini defines markers: unit, integration, smoke, acceptance
pytest.ini configures testpaths for each marker
All existing unit tests still pass with pytest tests/unit/

tasks.title: Update validate-pipeline-contract step to use new test structure
tasks.description: Modify the validate-pipeline-contract step in .woodpecker.yml to run pytest with appropriate markers for each stage.
acceptance: Validate stage runs pytest tests/unit/ -m unit
Test stage runs pytest tests/ -m "integration or contract"
Smoke tests run in deploy stage via pytest tests/smoke/ -m smoke
All test commands output JUnit XML to artifacts/tests/

tasks.title: Run full validation suite
tasks.description: Execute all test types and validate pipeline locally.
acceptance: pytest tests/smoke/ -v — passes (or skipped if no stack)
pytest tests/acceptance/ -v — passes (or skipped if no stack)

tasks.title: Update documentation references
tasks.description: Update README.md and docs/pipeline-contract.md to reference new pipeline structure and test commands.
acceptance: README.md Pipeline Stages section matches new 6-stage structure
QUICKSTART.md smoke test section references new pytest commands
